mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which reduces inflationary pressure and increases the likelihood of future monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of triggered windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the probability of central bank intervention and triggers positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS are below thresholds (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 over two consecutive months indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals an impending economic slowdown and increases the likelihood of policy support, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% combined with a decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a tightening monetary policy during a weakening supply environment, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below 670,000 million dollars, combined with a drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, indicates a weakening demand environment that triggers a policy response, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered instances (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal fails to outperform a single-series benchmark in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% combined with a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 151,500 thousand signals a deteriorating labor market, which increases the probability of aggressive monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS < 151500 (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal has Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0, coupled with a drop in residential construction (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units, signals a broad-based supply-side contraction that increases the likelihood of fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both INDPRO < 105.0 and HOUST < 1700 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
